# Octail eggs

[![Validate eggs](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/actions/workflows/validate.yml)

The game-server eggs [Octail](https://github.com/sneakywrld) ships and tests: 129 eggs, one JSON file
per game, in a folder per category. They use the Pterodactyl and Pelican egg formats (`PTDL_v2`,
`PLCN_v1`–`PLCN_v3`) with Octail's additions in `x_octail` (category, server tools, extra ports, RCON, idle sleep,
install sandbox, resource hints, start detection by port), which other panels ignore. Every egg runs on our own runtime images,
[octail-yolks](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-yolks).

This repository is generated from `octail/eggs/` in the Octail monorepo on every publish: change eggs there, not
here (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)). Every egg's `meta.update_url` points at its own file below, so
**Check for updates** on a panel follows this repository.

**Requests and fixes:** [open an issue](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/issues/new/choose) (an egg bug or a new egg). What changed in each publish is
in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## Importing

- **Panel**: Admin → Eggs → Import eggs → **GitHub**, with `https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs` for everything, or a folder such as
  `https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/minecraft`.
- **Command line** on the panel host:

  ```bash
  octail egg:import https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs --dry-run
  octail egg:import https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/steam
  octail egg:import https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/main/minecraft/paper.json
  ```

- **One egg**: its raw address (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/main/<folder>/<egg>.json`) under **Web address**; Octail keeps it
  as the egg's update address.
- **Updates**: Admin → Eggs → **Check for updates** (or `octail egg:update --all`) shows what changed here since
  the import and pulls the newer versions you pick.

Imported install scripts need a staff review before they run, except scripts identical to the ones Octail ships.

| [Terraria](#terraria) | [`terraria/`](terraria) | 3 | Terraria, vanilla and tModLoader |
| [Steam games](#steam-games) | [`steam/`](steam) | 55 | other games installed with SteamCMD |
| [SteamCMD](#steamcmd) | [`steamcmd/`](steamcmd) | 1 | the generic SteamCMD egg for any game with an app id |
| [Standalone games](#standalone-games) | [`standalone/`](standalone) | 16 | games downloaded from their own sites |
| [Voice servers](#voice-servers) | [`voice/`](voice) | 2 | voice chat servers: TeamSpeak 3 and Mumble |
| [Apps](#apps) | [`apps/`](apps) | 4 | generic Node.js, Python, Java and Go apps such as Discord bots |
| [Testing](#testing) | [`testing/`](testing) | 1 | the tiny shell "game" Octail uses in CI and on test nodes |

File names are the game without the folder prefix (`minecraft/paper.json`, `terraria/tmodloader.json`). Paths
never change once published: they are the update addresses of every panel that imported them. Each folder has a
README of its own listing its eggs.

## Eggs

Extra ports are the ports Octail assigns next to the primary one (`+1` = primary port + 1). Notes: RCON (and its protocol), the Players tab or a player count, idle sleep (wake on connect), Wine/Proton and other things to know.

Tested: the last real run of the egg on one of our nodes with the image it ships (install, ready line or bound port, a console command, stop): ✓ passed, ✗ failed, — not run on these images yet. Details in [TESTED.md](TESTED.md).

## Validation

`node tools/validate.mjs` (no dependencies) checks every egg on each push and pull request. It runs the egg format
rules Octail's own importer runs (`tools/egg-format.mjs`, the same file): an egg the panel would refuse, or import
with a warning (unknown variable rules, malformed `x_octail` features, …), fails. On top of that: the required
fields, SteamCMD installs retry the download, installs that check for the server binary exit 1 when it is
missing, no `http://` downloads, and update addresses point at the egg's own file. Every image is one of ours (`ghcr.io/sneakywrld/octail-yolks`); upstream Pterodactyl, Pelican and parkervcp images are refused.

[NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)) with Octail's changes listed in each file's `_comment`. A licence for Octail's own
additions hasn't been chosen yet.
